source.name: Pressing Tab in an open date field must move focus to the next form field
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/mymth/vanillajs-datepicker/issues/156) at 6156648a4cbcb662d4e1f5f4b449adf0f9a67759. Blind to the maintainers' fix 1533350d5ea7d790ea36fcdaf4bcbfd170ddcfab; routing auto.

journey.title: Tab out of the visit date into the access notes
journey.goal: Pressing Tab in the open date field moves focus to the next form field so the user can keep typing

functionalJourney.title: Pick a visit date with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the visit date field

guards.title: Pick the next day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys move the calendar focus and Enter commits the date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker's keydown listener prevents the default action of the Tab key, trapping focus inside the datepicker popup and blocking navigation to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Datepicker constructor to intercept Tab (and Shift+Tab) events, hide the datepicker, and allow default tab traversal, while delegating all other keys to the original keydown handler.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab or Shift+Tab from the date input will move focus to the next or previous focusable element in the tab order, allowing keyboard-only users to exit the datepicker without needing to close it via mouse or Escape.
functional_risks: Hiding the datepicker on Tab could interfere with users who expect to navigate within the datepicker using Tab, but the datepicker relies on arrow keys for internal navigation, so the risk is low.
Ensure that Shift+Tab also works to move focus backward.
verification_requirements: Tab from #visit-date moves focus to #notes and hides the datepicker.
Shift+Tab from #visit-date moves focus to #contact (previous field) and hides the datepicker.
ArrowRight then Enter still selects the next day (regression guard).
Datepicker still opens on focus and mouse click.
